novel_features.name: Chrome session auth
novel_features.description: Import Google session cookies from Chrome without manual DevTools copying.
novel_features.rationale: NotebookLM has no public API key; cookie auth is the only practical agent path.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use once after logging into Google in Chrome to enable all live commands.

novel_features.name: Offline notebook search
novel_features.description: Search synced notebooks locally by title or id without another API round-trip.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local SQLite cache populated by sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you need fast recall across many notebooks in scripts.

novel_features.name: Grounded chat with citations
novel_features.description: Ask questions against notebook sources via streamed batchexecute RPC.
novel_features.rationale: Mirrors notebooklm-py chat wire format in a static Go binary.
novel_features.example: notebooklm-pp-cli chat ask "Research" "What are the main themes?" --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for agent loops that need cited answers from uploaded sources.

novel_features.name: Studio quiz generation
novel_features.description: Kick off NotebookLM Studio quiz artifact generation and optionally wait for completion.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps undocumented Studio RPCs not exposed by curl.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to produce study materials from a notebook's sources.

novel_features.name: Doctor health gate
novel_features.description: Validate config, cookie presence, and session bootstrap tokens before live calls.
novel_features.rationale: Agents need a deterministic preflight when cookies expire silently.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run after auth login or when list commands return empty results.

troubleshoots.symptom: notebook list returns empty or RPC errors
troubleshoots.fix: Re-run `notebooklm-pp-cli auth login --chrome` after logging into Google in Chrome, then `doctor --json`.
Run `notebooklm-pp-cli sync --json` first to populate the local cache.

recipes.title: Create notebook and add a URL source
recipes.command: notebooklm-pp-cli notebook create "Agent Research" --json && notebooklm-pp-cli source add "Agent Research" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NotebookLM --json
recipes.explanation: Bootstrap a fresh notebook with a public web source.
